name: zclass_camera_build_frustum_grid_tiles_from_params
description: zClass_Camera::BuildFrustumGridTilesFromParams builds frustum grid rings from the camera footprint while preserving raw out-of-bounds grid offsets.
known_limits: Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because dense x87 min/max tests, stack-argument reuse, and diamond-ring tile writes still render with HLIL artifacts.
No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this camera frustum-grid helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent camera source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44c8e0 validates clearing all 50 tile rings, WorldToGridCoordsClampedEx origin/min/max conversions, camera footprint setup, min/max row swaps, raw grid iteration with clamped area lookup, area-index filtering, optional out-of-bounds position offsets, frustum clip testing only for in-bounds cells, diamond-ring indexing, and ring/tile writes.
The native camera frustum-grid smoke verifies a controlled out-of-bounds footprint produces one in-bounds tile and three clamped-offset tiles in the expected clamped diamond ring.
